beats.summary: Michael and team prepare to recruit interns at a high school job fair with minimal materials.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Today I'm heading over to the job fair at Valley View High School, to find some new interns.
Pam (holds up single sheet of paper): Um, that's all we brought.

beats.summary: Michael is frustrated when a student signs the single sheet of paper meant as a blank canvas for hopes and dreams.

beats.summary: Jim meets a potential client on the golf course as part of his probation and tries to make a good impression.

evidence.snippet: Jim: Today, I am meeting a potential client on the golf course, because Ryan put me on probation.
Jim: So I guess I'll just… work on my short game.

beats.summary: Andy jokes about his golf skills and blisters from practice while interacting with Phil and Kevin.

evidence.snippet: Andy: Hit about 1200 balls last night, in preparation for today, so hands are a little tender.
Andy: People assume I'm great at golf. But like everybody, I hated golf lessons when I was a kid.

beats.summary: Dwight asserts authority over the office staff in Michael's absence, but Stanley leaves despite warnings.

evidence.snippet: Stanley, do not walk out that door! If you walk out that door, so help me, I will – He left.
